name: claude-lite
description: Lightweight wrapper around the Claude Code CLI: markdown chat tabs, model config, live context bar, global chat history.

commands.title: Claude Lite: Open Current Chat as Markdown

claudeLite.claudePath.description: Path to the claude executable (Windows mode).

claudeLite.useWsl.description: Run claude inside WSL (wsl.exe -- bash -lc claude).

claudeLite.checkForUpdates.description: On startup, compare the installed claude version with the latest published one (npm registry, same channel as the CLI's autoUpdatesChannel) and warn if it is out of date. Never updates by itself; the warning offers to run `claude update` in a terminal.

claudeLite.defaultModel.description: Default model (blank = CLI default). Use an alias/ID or display name from the chat's model dropdown, e.g. opus, sonnet, fable, haiku, claude-opus-5-5, "Opus 5.5". Append [1m] for 1M context. Checked against the CLI's model list; invalid values fall back to the default with a warning.

claudeLite.defaultEffort.description: Effort level (--effort). Levels the chosen model doesn't support fall back to the CLI default.

claudeLite.defaultPermissionMode.description: No interactive prompts in this wrapper: tools that would need approval are denied (and reported).

claudeLite.extraArgs.description: Extra CLI args appended to every claude invocation.

claudeLite.deepseek.enabled.description: Route every chat through DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible API instead of Anthropic (sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW on each claude process). Toggled by the DeepSeek button in the chat top bar; a running chat restarts on the next send.

claudeLite.deepseek.authToken.description: DeepSeek API key, sent as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN while DeepSeek mode is on. Stored in settings.json in plain text (and synced if Settings Sync is on).

claudeLite.deepseek.baseUrl.description: DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible base URL (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) used while DeepSeek mode is on.

claudeLite.deepseek.models.description: Comma-separated model IDs offered in the model dropdown while DeepSeek mode is on. The CLI cannot list DeepSeek's models itself, so this setting is the list. Append [1m] for the 1M context window.

claudeLite.deepseek.autoCompactWindow.description: Context window Claude Code uses for auto-compaction in DeepSeek mode (CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW). 786432 (768k) is DeepSeek's recommended value for the [1m] models.
